verdict.rationale: Google maintains a dated 'Release notes' changelog for the Gemini API covering model launches, alias moves and feature releases. A companion deprecations page says deprecation announcements are made in the release notes and tracks shutdown dates per model. Alias movements (e.g. `gemini-flash-latest`) are called out explicitly in the entries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the changelog is kept current, and evidence of a subscription mechanism (RSS or email) for following updates.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: Maintained "Release notes" changelog for the Gemini API — dated entries for model launches, alias moves, and feature releases
Deprecation announcements are made on the Release notes page, and the announced earliest shutdown dates are tracked on this page.
This is now the model behind `gemini-flash-latest`
